question_cn: 「子力协调」在开局中最准确的含义是什么？
question_en: What is the most accurate meaning of piece coordination in the opening?

options.text_cn: 把所有棋子集中在同一个区域进行攻击
options.text_en: Concentrating every piece in one area to attack.

options.text_cn: 每个棋子都有明确任务，互相支援、分工覆盖，不重叠也不留空白
options.text_en: Each piece has a clear role, supports the others, and covers useful squares without needless overlap or gaps.

options.text_cn: 马和象总是走在一起，互相保护
options.text_en: Knights and bishops always move together and protect one another.

options.text_cn: 子力协调就是把所有棋子都出动
options.text_en: Piece coordination simply means developing every piece.

explanation_cn: 子力协调是指棋盘上每个棋子都有明确的战略任务，各司其职、互相配合：马控制格子，象覆盖斜线，车占线路，后作后盾。好的协调意味着无冗余（没有两个棋子做同一件事）、无空白（没有重要区域无人看管）。协调差的棋子再多也难以产生威力。
explanation_en: Piece coordination means each piece has a clear strategic task and works with the others: knights control squares, bishops cover diagonals, rooks occupy files, and the queen supports the position. Good coordination avoids both redundancy and gaps in coverage. Even many pieces can be ineffective when they do not work together.
